original.target_description: Zhang et al. (2018), accepted manuscript, single cold-pressor/control study of frontal asymmetry and stress; requested individual test not uniquely specified.

notes: Primary source is the 29-page publisher accepted manuscript, not the final 9-page typeset article. Locator p.17 includes multiple ANOVA main effects, interactions, electrode-specific interactions and t tests. Requested metric is test statistic, but no term, electrode pair, time contrast or outcome uniquely identifies one. The neutral description covers the study generally. Requested original test cannot be selected without guessing; unavailable statistic fields reflect insufficient target identification, not an unavailable paper. Unassigned replication side is intentionally unavailable. Canonical primary TXT was read; target PDF pages were visually checked where locators were supplied. No statistics were inferred from row ordering.
